WERONIKA · SETTINGS
AI Brain
Ordinary chat uses the cloud brain. Signed-in app pages and private email/DM/calendar text stay on this PC and use local Ollama only. First use opens a separate browser profile for manual sign-in; sending, saving events, and answering calls require your confirmation.
Local media workflows
No image, song, or video generation service is connected. Weronika prepares a copyable prompt for a locally installed generator; no media file is generated here.
Use a local workflow such as ComfyUI / Forge for images, Wan / LTX for video, or ACE-Step / YuE2 for music. Weronika does not send these requests to a media-generation API.

Google · Gmail + Calendar + Drive

        
Checking Google connection…

        

          
          
        

        

          
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
Create in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web app). Add redirect: http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/google/callback — enable Gmail, Calendar, Drive APIs. Paste ID/Secret here, save, then Connect.

        

        

          
          
          
          
          
          
        

        
Weronika reads/writes via official Google APIs after you connect. Day planner uses Calendar, Drive organizer groups by type and moves files, Gmail lets you list/read/send with confirmation. Your chat history persists across shutdowns.

      


      

        
Same-browser automation

        
Same-browser mode: automation runs in the tab where Weronika is open — no separate Chrome test browser. For full tab control, run Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222.

        
Try: “open telegram and send message to boss that I am on leave today and send him”, “open youtube and play Barsaat”, “play Sahiba on Spotify”, “play a video of Techno Gamer playing GTA 5 and comment that it is great”. Instagram/WhatsApp/Telegram work for any contact. Private reading uses Ollama when available.

      


      

        
Data

        
      


      
For signed-in apps, Weronika works in your current browser profile (same-browser). For full tab control, start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222. Fallback still works with a local Chromium profile. Try “read my Gmail inbox”, “summarize my WhatsApp messages”, “play [title] on Spotify”, or “check my Google Calendar”. For pasted private text, prefix it with “Private:”. Private app text never falls back to cloud AI. Sending, event saves, and call answering need a final confirmation.
